panels.title: Checklist coverage (did each test type run?)

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.label AS "test type", CASE WHEN x.ran THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS ran, coalesce(x.tests,0) AS tests, coalesce(x.passed,0) AS passed, coalesce(x.failed,0) AS failed, coalesce(x.findings,0) AS findings FROM (VALUES ('functional','Functional (code-derived)'),('ui','UI & resize / accessibility'),('security','Security / penetration (non-destructive)'),('load','Load / performance'),('unit','Unit tests (codebase)'),('stability','Stability & UX')) AS c(key,label) LEFT JOIN (SELECT key AS category, (value->>'ran')::boolean AS ran, coalesce((value->>'tests')::int,0) AS tests, coalesce((value->>'pass')::int,0) AS passed, coalesce((value->>'fail')::int,0) AS failed, coalesce((value->>'blocked')::int,0) AS blocked, coalesce((value->>'findings')::int,0) AS findings FROM runs r, jsonb_each(coalesce(r.stats::jsonb->'categories','{}'::jsonb)) WHERE r.id = '${run}') x ON x.category=c.key ORDER BY c.label

SELECT c.label AS category, coalesce(x.passed,0) AS passed, coalesce(x.failed,0) AS failed, coalesce(x.blocked,0) AS blocked FROM (VALUES ('functional','Functional (code-derived)'),('ui','UI & resize / accessibility'),('security','Security / penetration (non-destructive)'),('load','Load / performance'),('unit','Unit tests (codebase)'),('stability','Stability & UX')) AS c(key,label) LEFT JOIN (SELECT key AS category, (value->>'ran')::boolean AS ran, coalesce((value->>'tests')::int,0) AS tests, coalesce((value->>'pass')::int,0) AS passed, coalesce((value->>'fail')::int,0) AS failed, coalesce((value->>'blocked')::int,0) AS blocked, coalesce((value->>'findings')::int,0) AS findings FROM runs r, jsonb_each(coalesce(r.stats::jsonb->'categories','{}'::jsonb)) WHERE r.id = '${run}') x ON x.category=c.key ORDER BY c.label

SELECT category, findings FROM (SELECT key AS category, (value->>'ran')::boolean AS ran, coalesce((value->>'tests')::int,0) AS tests, coalesce((value->>'pass')::int,0) AS passed, coalesce((value->>'fail')::int,0) AS failed, coalesce((value->>'blocked')::int,0) AS blocked, coalesce((value->>'findings')::int,0) AS findings FROM runs r, jsonb_each(coalesce(r.stats::jsonb->'categories','{}'::jsonb)) WHERE r.id = '${run}') x WHERE findings > 0

SELECT category, severity, status, route, title, standard_ref AS standard, round(confidence::numeric,2) AS confidence FROM findings WHERE run_id='${run}' ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'high' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, category
